# Fallout Prime series wins Emmy Awards: Offers & Events

![Fallout Prime series wins Emmy Awards: Offers & Events](/uploads/404_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The **Fallout Prime series** has been nominated 16 times and won two Emmys!

Nuka Knights warmly congratulates on the **Emmys for "Outstanding Music Supervision - 2024"** and **"Outstanding Emerging Media Program"**

The series really deserves it. Kilter Films and Bethesda have created a masterpiece that does justice to the Fallout game series. The series has rightly drawn the attention of many new players to the topic of Fallout and has also caused a large flood of new players in Fallout 76. We are all very excited to see what happens next in the second season.

To celebrate this award, there are numerous **offers** as well as **free items** in the Fallout games this week.

## Fallout Offers

Various Fallout games will be on offer from September 13th. Among other things, there is a 75% discount on Fallout 3 for Xbox and 60% discount on Fallout 4 for PlayStation. We have compiled all the exciting offers below:

**Xbox deals: September 13th until September 17th**

- Fallout 3 (Xbox 360): -75%
- Fallout 3 GOTY (PC): -75%
- Fallout 4 GOTY: -75%
- Fallout 4 Season Pass: -60%
- Fallout 76
- Deluxe: -60%
- Upgrade: -40%
**Sony PlayStation Offers**

- Weekend offer: September 13th until 16.09.
- Fallout 4: -60%
- Fallout 4 DLC: -50%
- Planet of Discounts: September 11th until September 25th
- Fallout 4 GOTY: -60%
- Fallout 4 Season Pass: -60%

**Offers at GOG**

- Post-Apo Promo: September 10th until 17.09.

## Fallout Shelter

In Fallout Shelter you will receive from September 16th. until September 20, 2024:

3 lunch boxes, 1 pet transport box and 10 Nuka-Colas for free. 

## Bethesda Gear Store Discount

There's tons of cool Fallout gear to pick up at the Bethesda Gear Store - perfect gifts for the Fallout fans in your life (or for yourself). Use the code **OKEYDOKEY** to get 20% off select items **from September 15th to September 30th**.

Nuka Knights is a Bethesda Gear Ambassador. If you want to support Nuka Knights, you can use this code, which also gives you a **20% discount**: **BTPTSNK092** (valid until September 24th, 2024). *If you use this code, Nuka Knights will receive a commission.*

Click here to go to the Bethesda Gear Store

## Fallout 76: Free Vault 33 Suit

If you haven't claimed the Vault 33 suit (underarmor) yet, it will be available now from September 17th. another week's opportunity to do so!

![Vault 33 Suit](/uploads/vault33suit.jpg)

## Fallout 76: Surprise Events

And there is another surprise for all Fallout 76 players. From **16.09. The double EP weekend is extended until September 19th**! The events are also running:

![Double EP Weekend](/uploads/doublexp-blue-devil-1920x870.jpg)

Sources: emmys.com, bethesda.net
